reviews.comment:
El mejor ACA de Buenos Aires hasta Mar del Plata. La atención en la gasolinera es excelente. Para destacar el restaurante y el bar, excelentes platos y sandwiches. Precios economicos.
También tienen fiambres, quesos y dulces excelentes para comprar.

(Translated by Google)
The best ACA from Buenos Aires to Mar del Plata. The service at the gas station is excellent. The restaurant and bar are also worth mentioning, with excellent dishes and sandwiches. Affordable prices.
They also have excellent cold cuts, cheeses, and sweets for purchase.
